{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge crew-neck knit, regular fit, hip length, sage green #6B8A80, merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, high waist, ankle length, chocolate brown #5A4636, wool-blend crepe
Single-breasted blazer, slightly tailored, hip length, oatmeal camel #C2A27C, textured wool tweed
Leather loafers, almond toe, low heel, cognac #8B5A3C, smooth calf leather
Slim belt, 2 cm wide, cognac #8B5A3C, smooth leather
Small hoop earrings, warm gold #C9A24B, polished metal
Structured tote bag, medium size, chocolate brown #5A4636, grained leather

This outfit sits squarely in neat office dress: a refined knit with tailored trousers, a textured jacket and loafers. The sage green knit picks up the grey-green of your eyes, while the camel and chocolate tones are warm enough to flatter your skin and golden hair. The high-waisted trousers and the slightly tailored jacket give a clean, balanced line, and the long straight leg keeps the look polished. The jacket is easy to take off if the office is warm, and the cognac leather accents tie the shoes, belt and warm metal together."}
